plan.message:
Decode payload first. Split on ASCII spaces retaining empty fields. Scan fields left to right, numbering input fields from 1. ~i,n; emits a copy of the n output fields ending at the end of input field i's expansion; i must be earlier. Other fields emit literally. Join output fields with ASCII spaces, preserving everything else. Print only.
